entries.definition: Burning from a recent hit, taking damage over time. Some follow-up attacks become stronger against a burning target.
An enemy with no allied champions, minions or outer turrets close to them. Some abilities do extra damage to them.
Lifted into the air, unable to move or act until landing.
Hitting an enemy from a distance to wear down their health before a real fight starts.
Cannot move for a short time, though abilities and attacks still work.
Cannot cast abilities for a short time.
Moves more slowly for a short time.
Unable to move, attack or cast for a short time.
